# gigahost_servers (Data Source)

Returns all servers on your gigahost.no account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gigahost_servers" "example" {}

output "server_ids" {
  value = [for s in data.gigahost_servers.example.servers : s.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) Every server on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `bandwidth` (Number) Included bandwidth in GB.
- `cores` (Number) Virtual CPU cores.
- `created_at` (Number) When the server was created (Unix seconds).
- `hostname` (String) Hostname configured on the server.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier.
- `label` (String) User-assigned label.
- `location` (String) Datacentre location reported by the API.
- `primary_ip` (String) Primary IPv4 address.
- `ram` (Number) Memory in GB.
- `status` (String) Power and provisioning state: `running`, `off`, `installing` or `rescue`.
- `type` (String) Server type reported by the API.
- `vps_type` (String) Virtualisation type reported by the API.
